# nixos

Personal configuration for two NixOS hosts (`desktop`, `vm`), a full
nix-darwin Mac (`personal-mac`), and a standalone Home Manager profile for a
second Mac (`work-mac`).

## Ownership

- NixOS and `personal-mac`: Nix owns packages, dev tools, system defaults,
  and dotfiles. `personal-mac` limits Homebrew to GUI casks declared in
  `modules/hosts/personal-mac/default.nix`.
- `work-mac`: Homebrew owns packages and applications; Home Manager owns
  dotfiles only. Do not add macOS packages to Home Manager. The Home Manager
  command itself is the sole Nix-managed program in this profile.
- Do not add repository helper scripts. Use standard Nix, Home Manager, and
  Brew commands documented in README.md.

## Structure

- `flake.nix`: minimal flake-parts entry point.
- `modules/parts.nix`: supported systems and shared flake modules.
- `modules/checks.nix`: treefmt, pre-commit, and the development shell.
- `modules/user.nix`: personal identity, home, SSH, and flake-location values.
- `modules/common/`: shared NixOS modules.
- `modules/features/`: optional NixOS features.
- `modules/hosts/`: `desktop`, `vm`, `personal-mac`, and `work-mac` outputs.
- `modules/home/`: Home Manager modules.
- `modules/files/`: tracked dotfile sources.

`import-tree` loads every `.nix` file under `modules/`; do not add manual
flake-level import lists.

## Shell configuration

`modules/files/shared/zsh/common.zsh` contains cross-platform interactive
behavior. NixOS plugin loading stays in `modules/home/zsh.nix`; macOS plugin
loading and PATH setup stay under `modules/files/macos/zsh/`. Brew installs the
macOS plugins directly.

## Git identities

NixOS and `personal-mac` use the personal Git identity from `flake.lib.user`.
The `work-mac` profile includes `~/.config/git/work.conf` as its identity for
every repository. Actual work names, emails, signing keys, domains, and other
work identity values must never enter Nix or this repository. Keep
`user.useConfigOnly=true`.

## Auto-upgrade

`desktop` and `personal-mac` both rebuild and switch to the latest flake
output unattended once a day (`system.autoUpgrade` on `desktop`, a `launchd`
daemon on `personal-mac`). `vm` and `work-mac` do not self-update.

## Continuous integration

`check.yml` evaluates all four host outputs and runs `treefmt`/`pre-commit`
on every push and pull request. `update-flake-lock.yml` opens a daily
`flake.lock` update PR and auto-merges it once `check` passes. Branch
protection on `main` requires the `check` status check.

## Commands

- NixOS/`personal-mac` activation: `nh os switch`
- `work-mac` activation: `home-manager switch --flake ~/nix#work-mac`
- Validation: `nix flake check`
- Formatting: `nix fmt`

## Rules

- Keep related configuration together.
- Prefer direct NixOS/Home Manager options over custom abstractions.
- Use `flake.lib.user` for system account and home-path values.
- Do not put work identity, internal names, credentials, or secrets in the
  repository or Nix store.
- Use explicit package and library references outside a short package list.
- `nixfmt` is the only Nix formatter.
